name: io.github.Essatt/knowman-mcp
description: KnowMan MCP server: search, ask, save and read your Knowledge Base from any MCP client.

environmentVariables.name: KNOWMAN_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your KnowMan API key (create one at https://app.knowman.io)

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. Clients that support MCP OAuth sign in through the consent page and need no header. Otherwise send a KnowMan API key as `Bearer <key>` (create one at https://app.knowman.io).
